title: Gravity and Colony Anew
author: Mirabel Iversen
blurb: Casper Thackeray, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
